jcr:title: Sling Models and Component Development
author: cms-admin
body:
Sling Models provide a powerful way to map JCR resources to Java objects in Apache Sling. They use annotations to inject resource properties and adapt resources to strongly-typed model objects that can be used in HTL templates.

The @Model annotation marks a class as a Sling Model, while @Inject annotations automatically populate fields from resource properties. Sling Models support inheritance, validation, and custom injection strategies.

In component development, Sling Models separate business logic from presentation, making components more testable and maintainable. They work seamlessly with HTL templates and support features like resource adaptation and post-construction processing.
summary: How Sling Models enable clean component development and resource adaptation in Sling.
tags: Sling Models, Component Development, HTL, Resource Adaptation, Dependency Injection
title: Sling Models and Component Development
